title: 超濾膜前處理
summary: 本課以UF 進水預處理、通量、完整性與淨產水為主線，從進水組成與孔徑邊界、攔截與預處理試驗、膜面積與通量、跨膜壓與壓力量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops uf feed conditioning, flux, integrity and net production through ten connected units, beginning with feed constituents and separation boundary, screening and pretreatment trials, membrane area and flux, transmembrane pressure measurement. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 跨膜壓與壓力量測：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Transmembrane pressure measurement: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 跨膜壓與壓力量測 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Transmembrane pressure measurement and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 依流道定義取進水、濃水及產水壓力；單一入口壓力不一定是 TMP。
steps.instructionEn: Use feed, concentrate and permeate pressures for the specified flow configuration; inlet pressure alone is not necessarily TMP.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進水壓=1.2 bar；濃水壓=0.8 bar；透過側=0.1 bar。模型 TMP=(Pf+Pr)/2-Pp，代入得到 0.9 bar。適用邊界：簡化沿程平均；壓力取點與靜水頭須一致。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Feed pressure=1.2 bar; concentrate=0.8 bar; permeate=0.1 bar. Model TMP=(Pf+Pr)/2-Pp gives 0.9 bar. Applicability: Simplified axial mean; tap elevations and hydrostatic head must be consistent.
steps.failure: 忽略產水背壓而高估驅動力。診斷與介入：校正三個壓力點及高程，確認所用膜流道定義。
steps.failureEn: Permeate backpressure is ignored, overstating driving force. Diagnostic response: Calibrate the three pressure points/elevations and confirm membrane-flow configuration.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「跨膜壓與壓力量測」的觀測點。校正三個壓力點，並記錄取壓高程。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transmembrane pressure measurement. Calibrate all three pressure points and record their elevations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.instruction: UF 出水仍須分析溶解鹽、可溶有機物及氧化劑等 RO 相容條件；完整前處理鏈需獨立驗證。
